hypothesis: A trajectory-resetting EMA of the previous-window physical RMS residual, used as the additive scale in half=α|pred|+k σ_t with σ_0=σ_global and (α, λ, k) selected by maximum official SPS on the E006 train-Re calibration split, will raise v1_val SPS by at least 1.0 over E007's 35.067, keep Rel-L2/TKE/MVPE within 0.01 of E004, keep Time at least 86, and raise coverage above E006's 66.599%.
comparator: E007 frozen E004 with (0.025, 0.1) on real_regime_v1 validation via local_bench_v1

decision_criterion.accept_rule: Local: train cal/audit SPS gains vs official default ±5%. Official-protocol v1_val: Rel-L2/TKE/MVPE within 0.01 of E004, Time >= 86, SPS >= 36.067, coverage > 0.665994. Do not retune after the look. E012 is a diagnostic, not a gate.

interval.formula: half_width = alpha * abs(point_prediction) + k * sigma_t; sigma_t = decay * sigma_{t-1} + (1-decay) * rms(pred_{t-1}-target_{t-1}); sigma_0 = sigma_global
interval.selection: maximum calibration SPS; ties break by smaller mean half-width, then smaller alpha, then smaller k, then larger decay
interval.reset: sigma and cached previous prediction cleared at every trajectory boundary

evaluation.adaptation: none; online residual updates only the interval scale
evaluation.point_predictions: frozen E004; bounds only change SPS
